scope: Per-event classifier wall-clock latency; synthetic holdout, not production accuracy. Uncalibrated model probabilities.
batch_latency_scope: One 66-event batch: classification, in-memory SQLite persistence/commit/read and correlation; excludes HTTP, disk I/O and browser rendering.
limitations: Synthetic fixture holdout shares templates with training; it is a smoke benchmark, not an independent generalization estimate.
The official hidden test set, baseline detector, and published campaign scoring definition have not been supplied.
Model probabilities are uncalibrated. AI authorship and polymorphic malware cannot be proven from these logs.
Per-event latency measures feature extraction and inference only, not network transport or UI polling.
